build_transform_gen: build a list of Detectron2 transform generators from a config node and transform representation strings
parse_tfm_gen_repr: parse a transform generator representation string into name and optional argument string separated by double colon
register_resize_shortest_edge_op: register a ResizeShortestEdgeOp transform that resizes images by shortest edge using config min and max size settings
register_resize_shortest_edge_square_op: register a ResizeShortestEdgeSquareOp transform that resizes images to a square shape without keeping aspect ratio
register_resize_op: register a ResizeOp transform that resizes images using JSON-parsed keyword arguments for the Resize transform
